# Zenith AI

> AI-powered mental wellness companion with meditation, mood tracking, sleep tracking, journaling, community support, and personalized resources.

Zenith AI ("MindMate") is an empathetic conversational wellness platform for teens and adults. It combines an AI chat companion with structured tools for self-care: guided breathing, soothing music, sleep analytics, mood logging, journaling, and a moderated community.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Zenith AI and entry to the wellness companion.
- [MindMate Chat](/chat): AI wellness chat with tool-driven exercises (breathing, grounding, music).
- [Meditation](/meditation): Guided meditation timer and sessions.
- [Mood Tracking](/mood-tracking): Log moods, view trends, and reasons.
- [Resources](/resources): Library of mental wellness articles.
- [Breathing Exercises](/breathing-exercises): Box, 4-7-8, and other breathing patterns.
- [Soothing Music](/soothing-music): Curated relaxation tracks.
- [Sleep Tracking](/sleep-tracking): Sleep schedule, quality logs, and analytics.
- [Daily Schedule](/daily-schedule): Recurring wellness routines.
- [Community](/community): Anonymous-friendly peer support forum.
- [Analytics](/analytics): Full wellness analytics dashboard with PDF export.

## Optional

- [Admin](/admin): Internal moderation console.
